annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she let herself count on me
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: seeing the whole $500 land with me probably felt like proof I'd used her

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she likely thinks I'm someone who takes and doesn't give
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she trusted me because we'd agreed to split everything

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: it makes sense she'd feel used
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: She expected a partner and then watched the payment go to me
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: Maybe she doesn't even want me there. I don't know that
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Deciding this fast feels risky, like I could make things worse either way

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Of course she'd read that as being used
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: she kept her side of the agreement, assumed I'd keep mine
annotations.pda_responsibility: rushing is how I got here

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She'd have assumed we'd work side by side
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Her feeling used lines up exactly with what she was expecting
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth... I'm frozen

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: to her, me skipping and keeping the pay probably reads as deliberate
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: She trusted our agreement, so to her

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she now thinks I only cared about the money
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: She believed a promise between friends meant something
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I'd be going back on my word twice

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She went in thinking we were a team
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: No wonder 'used' is the word she picked

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She thought our split meant fairness on both ends
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: from her view I pocketed her trust along with the cash
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: it stays undecided for now, uneasily

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She likely sees me as someone who broke the deal
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since she took our agreement at face value, that view makes sense
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm worried whichever I pick right now would be for the wrong reasons
